text: When she was seated at the little table with Clifford opposite she smiled and leaned forward on both elbows looking him in the face. “What are you doing here?” she demanded. “Waiting,” he replied, in accents of adoration. For an instant she turned and examined herself in the glass. The wide blue eyes, the curling hair, the straight nose and short curled lip flashed in the mirror an instant only, and then its depths reflected her pretty neck and back.
